shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and altcoins fell 3-10% in 24h on broad market risk-off sentiment.
Fed rate hike maintains tight monetary policy, boosting traditional assets over crypto.
US-Iran geopolitical tensions increase market anxiety, pushing investors to safe havens.
Bitcoin ETFs continue to show net inflows despite recent price declines.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains "Neutral" (47-55) despite market fluctuations.
